capability: Resolve a name to the nearest enclosing binding in a scope chain.
observed_failure:
thread 'the_innermost_binding_wins' panicked at tests/check.rs:
assertion `left == right` failed
  left: Some(1)
 right: Some(0)

operation_items.operation: resolve to the nearest enclosing binding
count the scopes crossed to the binding
a name with no binding is free
an inner scope never leaks past a shadowing binding

prompt_intro: The crate builds, but `resolve` returns the outermost matching binding instead of the nearest one. Return the distance to the nearest binding for the name (0 is the queried scope), or `None` when the name is free. Keep the public API.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text

shared_operation.audit: author annotation only; no inter-annotator agreement yet (P11.21 gap)
shared_operation.definition: Resolve each occurrence against the nearest enclosing binding for that name, distinguish free from bound occurrences, reject or reject-free an unbound name as the surface requires, and never leak an inner scope.
shared_operation.name: quantifier/scope resolution
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A surface is solved only when every task on that surface passes; the trio win requires all three surfaces and is never pooled across them.
